RikiVpn ("the App") is developed and published by Nitai Studio, an independent Indian app development studio. RikiVpn is provided "as is" for general privacy and network-connectivity purposes. It is not intended to facilitate, and must not be used for, any unlawful activity. Nitai Studio does not guarantee uninterrupted, error-free, or unrestricted access to any server, website, or online service while the VPN is active, and is not responsible for content accessed by users through the App.

All servers, free and premium, are available to every user at no cost and are supported entirely by ads. Premium servers ask you to watch one short optional video before connecting.

For questions, contact us at %1$s.
